pages.text: Choose oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, crimson or warped wood.$(br2)Boxes, driver’s seats, wheels, stools and cabinets have wood variants. Mix different woods on one wagon; conversion and recovery preserve each part’s material.

Upholstered cushions, covers and canopies support sixteen wool colours. Use matching wool in each recipe.$(br2)Wood-determining materials use supported vanilla species; auxiliary “any planks” may be modded. Replace the oak and white examples with your preferred wood and wool.
